title: Beautyworld Middle East stands out as a global fragrance hub amid Gulf tensions
summary: For its 30th edition, held in Dubai from October 6 to 8, 2026, Beautyworld Middle East reaffirmed its importance to the global fragrance industry despite regional geopolitical uncertainty. Exclusive creations, olfactory innovations and the international ambitions of Middle Eastern brands highlighted the region's growing influence on the global perfume scene.
